title: Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts vulnerability that allows…
description: Vikunja versions prior to 2.7.1 have a vulnerability that allows attackers holding a valid session to brute-force account passwords through unthrottled re-authentication endpoints. Specifically, attackers can repeatedly attempt password guesses via the /user/settings/totp/disable endpoint without triggering lockout mechanisms, enabling them to disable two-factor authentication (TOTP) without a code. This flaw can lead to persistent account takeover.
